Defender; reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)

Flash
Persist (When this creature dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a -1/-1 counter on it.)

Flash

cards.name: Trap Essence

cards.name: Trap the Trespassers
cards.oracleText: Secret council — Each player secretly votes for a creature you don't control, then those votes are revealed. For each creature with one or more votes, put that many stun counters on it, then tap it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)

cards.name: Rag Man
cards.oracleText: {B}{B}{B}, {T}: Target opponent reveals their hand and discards a creature card at random. Activate only during your turn.

cards.name: Trapjaw Tyrant
cards.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever this creature is dealt damage, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.

cards.name: Tibalt's Trickery
cards.oracleText: Counter target spell. Choose 1, 2, or 3 at random. Its controller mills that many cards, then exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card with a different name than that spell. They may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then they put the exiled cards on the bottom of their library in a random order.

cards.name: Trapfinder's Trick
cards.oracleText: Target player reveals their hand and discards all Trap cards.

cards.name: Trapped in the Screen
cards.oracleText:
Ward {2} (Whenever this enchantment becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
When this enchantment enters, exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.

cards.name: Trapeze Artist
cards.oracleText:
Flying
This creature enters by being flipped from a height of at least one foot (about 0.3 meters). If it lands face down or didn't turn over completely at least once during the flip, return it to its owner's hand.
